description: Land Acquisition - Compensations for the acquisitions of the Lanka in Wattala, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically dealing with the acquisition of specific land parcels by the State, deposit of statutory compensation, and detailed descriptions of land locations, names, lot numbers, and extents. This falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it primarily deals with land acquisition and property matters.
